Hey everyone!

Cole

notes.title: Captain Soda is shooting its way to PC, Nintendo Switch, and Xbox this year!
notes.notes:
Fellow captains!

We are pleased to announce Ray Flower Games is teaming up with indie game publisher Leoful to bring Captain Soda to PC, Nintendo Switch™, Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox One in 2024!

To celebrate, we have a few pieces of news to share with you today!

1. Watch the new announcement trailer

Have a taste of the carbonated action in the latest announcement trailer below!

[previewyoutube=Y8U-QCyOSi4;full][/previewyoutube]

2. Play the Captain Soda demo and tell us your thoughts

The latest version of the Captain Soda demo is now available to play! It gives you access to three levels from the full version of the game and a small taste of Endless mode. 

Tell us your thoughts about the demo on the discussion forums or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FG2rC6gH93C]Discord[/url].

The top 3 players in each Endless mode leaderboard (up to a total of 15 players) will win a free key for the full game that will be sent to you at launch!

[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EduahD7xdeHfP2JlYkdJvjjahbN43TbG7QKSR81tR-c/edit]Click here[/url] to read the full contest rules.

We will be kicking off a Kickstarter campaign for Captain Soda later this year, and there will be some fancy digital and physical rewards up for grabs. Stay tuned for more details by [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/leoful/captain-soda/]following the Kickstarter preview page[/url].

notes.title: Big Update: New Endless Mode!
notes.notes:
Hey ( •̀ ω •́ )✧

I've been working away on a new game mode and wanted to share more on it today. A new endless rogue-lite mode has been added to the game. This will have limited availability in the demo, but you can still try it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41853772/73585315b4f880bdcdfb11e87aeea1ddaf065764.png[/img]

--- New feature: Endless mode
- Clear endless randomly generated levels in an arcade rogue-like game mode!
- Levels reuse existing campaign mode levels but with entirely generated waves
- Choose a soda hero to play for the run
- Swap weapons by picking up new weapons in the level
- Acquire character upgrades for the run by leveling up through collecting money
- Don't like an upgrade? reroll it!
- Get score bonuses for taking no damage or beating the level quickly
- Endless mode uses separate save files from campaign mode
- Soda Hero unlock challenges
- High scores are recorded into leaderboards: Global and by soda hero
- Unlock more weapons and upgrades in runs with accumulating score over runs

If you have ideas or feedback for endless mode please share them here or on the Discord!

Cole

notes.title: Why do aliens want to invade earth?
notes.notes:
Heyo

Aliens in Captain Soda really love shiny things. It's why they invaded! They wanted to steal the world's money... for what purpose? Who really knows. What we do know is that if they collect enough money they become shiny themselves and turn gold! 

Somehow, enemies will drop more money than they picked up when they become gold... Like some kind of oyster that creates more sand instead of pearls, except that sand is money. 

[previewyoutube=mt6MRVJoGTw;full][/previewyoutube]

I thought this would be a fun little mechanic to add to the game that ties in with the lore, while also having a fun little nuance to money. 

Thanks for reading! Have a good day :)

Cole

notes.title: I added a really cool easter egg to the game!
notes.notes:
Yo

I added a really cool easter egg to the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41853772/6112ef3bfd2caad14ac0aeb2fe5cf0d62f987d23.png[/img]

If ever the game crashes, rather than a default error message you'll get a special message like this one! I added some fun text/ascii art to crash messages. This is just something that should make it a bit more fun to encounter a crash, and is a gift to those unlucky enough to crash. There's a few different ones it can pick, which it will do randomly, so if you want to see them, you gotta crash 'em all, I guess?

If you have some fun ideas for more text art I can include, post it here! I may just add it :)

Cole

notes.title: All the flavors of the rainbow
notes.notes:
SUP!

Check out this video of the game's soda flavors! 

[previewyoutube=4hXvcnLzq7E;full][/previewyoutube]

One of the Captain's main abilities is that he can change his flavor of soda! By doing so, he gains different powers... And sometimes attracts unwanted attention. 

Soda flavors in Captain Soda change up the game to add new mechanics and gameplay. You can unlock more flavors through completing pursuits per level -- challenges that test your skill! There's also a super secret Pilk flavor.... Can you unlock it? 

Cole

notes.title: Infinite Attack Canceling?
notes.notes:
I added a feature some time ago where you could cancel your attack if you used a different one, you know to make it more fun and have some tech to the gameplay? Well I was playing around with it, and....

[previewyoutube=Lj3DB4Qa37I;full][/previewyoutube]

Super crazy! A lot of fun too. I ended up putting a cap on it, but what do you think? Should I add it back?

notes.title: Indie Cup Celebration Festival Demo for Captain Soda
notes.notes:
Captain Soda will appear in the February Indie Cup Celebration Festival here on Steam starting at 8 am PST (11 am EST / 4 pm GMT) on February 14 - 21. For this event, a demo will be available for everyone to play! 

The demo will include most levels and content of the first world. Follow or wishlist the game now so you know when the demo will go live. The demo will be available for the duration of the event, and will be removed once the event ends, so get hyped to play it! 

I'm very excited to show the game off to new players, you can join the Discord in the meantime to follow along with the game's development, share your ideas and feedback, and possibly play the beta playtest after the demo ends! https://discord.gg/G2rC6gH93C

notes.title: The alpha playtest has finished.
notes.notes:
The alpha playtest has finally come to a close. Thank you to everyone who played in the event! If you haven't already, consider wishlisting the game! 

For those that played it I would love it if you left some feedback on what you liked and didn't like. (a big thank you to those that already did so! A lot of great feedback has been given that I will take into account). It's a short 5-minute survey. 
 
Feedback form: https://forms.gle/5VsdJj4ie6PGhM9v8 

As for the future of Captain Soda, I plan to keep developing more weapons, levels, enemies, and surprises  that I hope you will enjoy. The sound effects and music too, of course :P this was just a gameplay playtest, I purposefully didn't include sound because I only wanted to focus on the art, gameplay and feeling at this time. I may also conduct another playtest in the future with a select few to test all the content and sound before release. If you want to be one of those few, definitely join the Discord. 

Discord: discord.gg/G2rC6gH93C

Look forward to it!

Cole

notes.title: The alpha playtest starts now!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Cole here. 

The closed alpha playtest for Captain Soda starts now! Everyone who has signed up for the playtest can play immediately. Each day I will continually give access to more players, so even if you're late to the party you will still get a chance to play. 

The closed alpha playtest event for Captain Soda will run one week, [b]starting now until March 6 at 11:59 PM PST[/b]. The content that will be playable is the first area of the game consisting of [b]9 levels, 6 weapons, and 4 accessories[/b]. 

A short disclaimer: the game currently does not have sound or music. Eventually there will be but for the time being the art and gameplay is the main focus. 

I'm excited for all of you to get the chance to play it. After you've played it, it would help out a lot if you left some feedback on what you liked and didn't like about the game. There is a button in-game which will take you to a short form. 

Have fun! 

Cole

notes.title: Closed Alpha Test coming soon, don't miss out!
notes.notes:
I plan to host a week-long closed alpha test by the end of February, where you can get the chance to play the game yourself. The dates aren't settled yet, but they will be announced about a week before the event happens.

Captain Soda is still in active development, and there is a lot more I will be working out with the game. The current trailer is more of a gameplay preview than a trailer (it currently doesn't even have sound!) but no worries, that is well within the plan for the game, so look forward to when I reveal the magic of sound to the game. That will certainly be exciting :)

The purpose of this test will be to gather feedback from players like you, to better know where polish is needed, focus on what you would like from the game, and to find any glaring issues with the game. 

If you haven't already, wishlist now so you don't miss out on the event! 

Cole
